While PRM is used, the primary discovery workflow is DDA LFQ. No specific PTM enrichment (like phospho or glyco) was performed; the 'enrichment' mentioned is general protein fractionation via SDS-PAGE.

scope: an aliquot of 300 μL of a thawed whole milk sample was centrifuged at 1000g for 1 h at 4 °C to separate the upper-fat layer and lower skimmed milk. The fat layer was discarded

For data-dependent shotgun analysis, a total of 25 μg of protein was reduced with 25 mM dithiothreitol (DTT), alkylated with 75 mM iodoacetamide (IAA) followed by SDS-PAGE fractionation on a 12% Criterion XT Bis-Tris protein gel

For PRM analysis, skimmed milk (20 μg protein) was added with 1% (w/v) sodium deoxycholate (SDC) in 100 mM Tris and then reduced with 5 mM tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine (TCEP) and alkylated with 30 mM 2-chloroacetamide (CAA)
